notes.title: Cut Cut Buffet Released!
notes.content:
Hello everyone! Today we released Cut Cut Buffet for the HTC Vive into Early Access. We are excited to let people get their hands on the game because now the real development begins. Over the past few months we built a solid foundation for the game to grow to be the go to cutting (and more future mechanics) game. What we need the most now is any feedback the players (you guys) see fit to let us know. We will being watching the post here closely for ideas, bugs, improvements, and anything else.

Making weapons feel just right and cuts accurate is a major point of interest. While the cuts are extremely accurate, collision is still being adjusted and different techniques experimented. Let us know how it feels and feel free to give any suggestions or ideas on the topic. 

We plans to release updates every Friday along with a devlog posted here and in the reddit.com/r/cutcutbuffet subreddit where you can also provide feedback and ask any questions. Thanks for reading!
